flagship_project.name: Project API-Mesh-OS: Generative AI-Autonomous API Contract Synthesis, Real-Time Distributed Mocking & Self-Healing Gateway
flagship_project.pillar: Autonomous API Engineering Ecosystem & Global Edge Contract Verification
flagship_project.strategic_thesis: Postman is the universal interface of modern microservices. API-Mesh-OS converts static API collections into self-synthesizing, self-healing runtime meshes that automatically generate production code, live mocking environments, end-to-end chaos test suites, and dynamic security vulnerability audits directly from developer natural language specs.
flagship_project.tech_stack: TypeScript / Node.js, Rust (Edge Proxy & Mocking Runtime), Cloudflare Workers (Global Edge Distribution), Postgres with pgvector (Semantic API Index), WebAssembly (Plugin Sandbox), GraphQL / gRPC / AsyncAPI Spec Compilers
flagship_project.kpis: Generates 100% compliant multi-language client SDKs in <2 seconds; detects 99.4% of breaking API contract regressions pre-commit; adoption by 30M+ developers.
